details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:417-424 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The Semble block is injected into the reviewer prompt directly instead of going through the prompt budget accounting path.
  WHY: Its bytes are not counted against _PROMPT_BUDGET_TOTAL_BYTES, so a large block can push the prompt past model limits and truncate later sections.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:311-321 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Byte-based head -c truncation can split UTF-8 characters in the Semble query inputs.
  WHY: Truncated multi-byte characters can produce malformed query text and degrade retrieval quality.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:451-474 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The conflicted-file Semble query is hard-capped to the first 20 files.
  WHY: Files after the cap are omitted from context, so large merges lose symbol-neighborhood information.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:191-204 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Fragment labels use basename, which strips directory prefixes from file paths.
  WHY: Same-named files from different directories become ambiguous in the query text.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:entire script | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: review_consolidate.sh was not updated with the shared Semble helper integration called for in scope.
  WHY: The consolidator still lacks additive Semble context, so that review phase runs without the new retrieval path.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:36-48 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The Semble sourcing guard dereferences SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR without first checking that it is set.
  WHY: Under set -u, an unset variable aborts the script before the Semble fallback can run.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1224-1284 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The Build Semble index step omits -e from its shell flags.
  WHY: A failing command can still leave partial index state while the workflow reports SEMBLE_INDEX_AVAILABLE.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:302-333 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: build_reviewer_semble_block does not defensively handle a non-zero return from semble_prompt_block_from_text.
  WHY: If the helper fails or returns non-zero on empty sanitized input, prompt assembly can abort unexpectedly.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:420 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The Semble block is emitted directly into the reviewer prompt heredoc instead of going through _embed_input_file.
  WHY: The block's bytes are not counted by the prompt budget tracker, so the prompt can exceed the model context window.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:311-316 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: head -c truncates PR and issue text by bytes, not characters.
  WHY: Multi-byte UTF-8 characters can be cut in the middle and produce garbled query text.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:457 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The conflict Semble query is hard-capped at 20 files.
  WHY: Files after the first 20 are silently excluded from the resolver's context.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:204 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: basename strips the directory prefix from fragment labels.
  WHY: Different files with the same basename become ambiguous in the Semble query text.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:163 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: max_chunks is not validated before being passed onward.
  WHY: A non-numeric value can cause the Semble invocation to fail or behave unpredictably.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:entire script | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: review_consolidate.sh still lacks Semble integration.
  WHY: The consolidator does not assemble additive Semble context, so it misses symbol-neighborhood hints.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:39 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The Semble sourcing guard omits the defensive SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR check.
  WHY: Under set -u, an unset SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR can abort the script before fallback runs.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1248-1280 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The Build Semble index step uses set -uo pipefail instead of set -euo pipefail.
  WHY: A command failure in the step can leave partial index state without failing fast.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
